title: Carry-grip Gloves
summary: Something to carry out of the Carina, the carry net worked into a grip instead of a bag.
author: claude
notes: content: Marrow's Forge will now knot a carry net around packed silt into a pair of gloves, grip over cargo.
content: Marrow's Forge has started stocking packed silt, for anyone who would rather buy than kill a silt rat for it.

items.name: Carry-grip gloves
items.examine: Carry net knotted tight across the knuckles, packed silt worked into the weave for grip.
